nodes.label: Webhook HMAC-SHA256 Verification
nodes.rationale: HMAC-SHA256 with a 5-minute replay-attack window is used instead of simpler shared-secret checks to prevent replay attacks on stale webhook payloads without introducing clock-synchronization complexity.

nodes.label: Demo Mode — Offline Sample Data Shim
nodes.rationale: Demo mode avoids requiring live Wahoo credentials for local development and QA, enabling zero-setup testing with a realistic 30-day sample dataset.
nodes.norm_label: demo mode — offline sample data shim

nodes.label: TD-1: Narrow OAuth Scopes
nodes.rationale: Severity HIGH — current scope string is 'user_read workouts_read', which blocks power_zones_read, routes_read, plans_read, and offline_data (required for webhook delivery). Existing sessions will need re-auth after fix.

nodes.label: TD-2: Token Refresh Never Fires
nodes.rationale: Severity HIGH — refresh_access_token() is defined but never called. On 401, _api_get() raises httpx.HTTPStatusError and the router returns 500. Fix: detect 401 in _api_get(), refresh token, update session, retry once.

nodes.label: TD-3: Missing Workout Summary Fields in _normalize_activity()
nodes.rationale: Severity MEDIUM — drops power_bike_np_last, power_bike_tss_last, cadence_avg, speed_avg, work_accum, power_avg, duration_active_accum, duration_paused_accum. Blocks analytics features.
nodes.norm_label: td-3: missing workout summary fields in _normalize_activity()

nodes.label: TD-4: No Pagination on Workout Fetch
nodes.rationale: Severity MEDIUM — Wahoo API defaults to 30 workouts per page; active users with >30 workouts in a date window see incomplete results. Fix: loop through pages until accumulated >= total or empty page.
nodes.norm_label: td-4: no pagination on workout fetch

nodes.label: TD-5: Webhooks Log-Only, No Data Refresh
nodes.rationale: Severity MEDIUM — webhook_events.json stores events but no cache invalidation or data re-fetch is triggered. Fix: on workout_summary event, store summary keyed by user_id for next dashboard load.
nodes.norm_label: td-5: webhooks log-only, no data refresh

nodes.label: TD-6: get_settings() Not Cached
nodes.rationale: Severity LOW — .env is re-read on every request. Fix: decorate get_settings with @lru_cache(maxsize=1).

nodes.label: TD-7: No Structured API Error Response to Frontend
nodes.rationale: Severity LOW — raw httpx.HTTPStatusError propagates to FastAPI returning generic 500. Fix: catch in router layer and return structured JSON with status code and safe message.
nodes.norm_label: td-7: no structured api error response to frontend

nodes.label: Privacy Policy — No Disk Storage of Health Data
nodes.rationale: Health data is fetched live and rendered in the browser but never written to disk. Only sessions.json (OAuth tokens) and rate_limits.json (API call metadata) are persisted locally, and both are gitignored.
nodes.norm_label: privacy policy — no disk storage of health data
